_comment: Budgets checked by scripts/perf_check.py on every PR. Timings are LibreOffice on a CI runner, with roughly 3x headroom over local runs. edit_recalc_s is a duration edit near the top of the plan. OFFSET is allowed only in Tasks, for reading another row's calculated value (predecessor drivers, parent WBS, and the critical path's successor look-ups) (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Raise a budget only with a reason in the PR; never to hide a regression. v1.3 raised formulas_max (sample 30,000 -> 35,000, stress 125,000 -> 150,000) for earned value and the report lists: 18 Tasks columns (one formula per task each) and about 960 report cells; the edit time rose by 0.06 s at 1,000 tasks.
